course_info.faculty: Faculty of Arts and Social Sciences

catalog_course_description: Coverage of the basic concepts of Graphic Design, such as Typography, Page Layout and Image creation and processing and their basic interactions.
course_learning_outcomes: To learn how to build design systems that revolve around a logotype and consists of many diverse objects which make up a branding.
course_objective: This studio class is designed to introduce complex design principles and applications. Students will engage in projects that require a deep understanding of visual communication strategies, typography, branding, digital media, and develop a body of work that demonstrates their ability to solve design problems creatively. Students will be given a semester-long project: “designing a comprehensive branding system for an exsisting company”. The project consists of three phases (A, B, and C).

program_requirements.program: Visual Arts and Visual Communications Design
